```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8, dpi = 150,
  fig.align = if (knitr::is_html_output()) "center" else "default"
)

tab <- md_table

pct <- function(v, digits = 0) {
  ifelse(is.na(v), "", paste0(formatC(100 * v, format = "f", digits = digits), "%"))
}
yes_no <- function(v) {
  ifelse(is.na(v), "n/a", ifelse(v, "Yes", "No"))
}
cap <- function(s) paste0(toupper(substring(s, 1, 1)), substring(s, 2))
scale_txt <- function(s) paste0("from ", s[1], " to ", s[2])
list_txt <- function(v) {
  if (length(v) <= 1) return(paste(v, collapse = ""))
  paste0(paste(v[-length(v)], collapse = ", "), " and ", v[length(v)])
}

inds <- names(x$scales)
rounds <- sort(unique(x$data$round))
n_experts <- length(unique(x$data$expert))
multi_round <- length(rounds) > 1

st <- delphi_status(
  x, round = cfg$round, threshold = cfg$threshold,
  relative_to = cfg$relative_to, method = cfg$method,
  alpha = cfg$alpha, scheibe = cfg$scheibe, type = cfg$type,
  paired = cfg$paired
)
assessed <- tapply(st$round, st$indicator, unique)

stab <- if (multi_round) {
  delphi_stability(
    x, method = cfg$method, alpha = cfg$alpha, scheibe = cfg$scheibe,
    type = cfg$type, paired = cfg$paired
  )
} else {
  NULL
}

n_items <- length(x$items)
per_round <- tapply(x$data$expert[!is.na(x$data$value)],
                    x$data$round[!is.na(x$data$value)],
                    function(e) length(unique(e)))
nw <- function(n) {
  words <- c("one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "ten")
  ifelse(n >= 1 & n <= 10, words[pmin(pmax(n, 1), 10)], as.character(n))
}
plural <- function(n, word) paste0(nw(n), " ", word, if (n != 1) "s" else "")
overview_txt <- if (cfg$linked || !multi_round) {
  paste0("This report summarises the ratings collected in a Delphi study involving ",
         n_experts, " experts over ", plural(length(rounds), "round"), ".")
} else {
  paste0("This report summarises the ratings collected in a Delphi study over ",
         plural(length(rounds), "round"), ", with ",
         list_txt(paste0(per_round, " experts in round ", names(per_round))),
         ". The experts are not linked across rounds.")
}
facet_height <- 1.4 + 2.1 * ceiling(n_items / 4)
heat_height <- 1.8 + 0.42 * n_items

scale_desc <- vapply(
  inds, function(i) paste0(i, " (", scale_txt(x$scales[[i]]), ")"), character(1)
)
cut_offs <- vapply(inds, function(i) {
  s <- x$scales[[i]]
  w <- if (cfg$relative_to == "points") s[2] - s[1] + 1 else s[2] - s[1]
  format(round(cfg$threshold * w, 2))
}, character(1))
cut_txt <- if (length(unique(cut_offs)) == 1L) {
  paste0("IQR \u2264 ", cut_offs[1],
         if (length(inds) > 1) " for all indicators" else "")
} else {
  list_txt(paste0("IQR \u2264 ", cut_offs, " for ", inds))
}
denominator <- if (cfg$relative_to == "points") {
  "the number of points of the rating scale"
} else {
  "the range of the rating scale (maximum minus minimum)"
}
```

# Overview

`r overview_txt` The panel rated `r n_items` items on
`r plural(length(inds), "indicator")`: `r list_txt(scale_desc)`. Unless
otherwise stated, the assessment refers to round
`r list_txt(unique(as.character(assessed)))`.

```{r item-labels, results = "asis"}
if (!is.null(cfg$item_labels)) {
  cat("\n## Items\n\n")
  lab <- data.frame(
    Item = x$items,
    Statement = unname(cfg$item_labels[x$items])
  )
  lab$Statement[is.na(lab$Statement)] <- ""
  cat(tab(lab), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n")
}
```

# Methods

**Descriptive statistics.** For each item, round and indicator, the report
gives the number of ratings, the median, the first and third quartiles
(Q1, Q3) and the interquartile range (IQR = Q3 - Q1). Quantiles are
computed with the type `r cfg$type` algorithm of the R function quantile(). The relative IQR expresses the IQR as a share of
`r denominator`, so that dispersion can be compared across indicators rated
on different scales.

**Consensus.** An item is considered to have reached consensus when its IQR
does not exceed `r format(100 * cfg$threshold)`% of `r denominator`
(von der Gracht, 2012). On the scales used in this study, this corresponds to
`r cut_txt`.

```{r methods-stability, results = "asis"}
if (multi_round) {
  test <- if (cfg$paired) "paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test" else
    "Wilcoxon rank-sum (Mann-Whitney) test"
  base <- if (cfg$paired) "the paired experts" else "the respondents"
  crit <- switch(cfg$method,
    wilcoxon = paste0(
      "an item is considered stable when the ", test, " comparing the two ",
      "rounds is not significant at the ", format(cfg$alpha), " level"
    ),
    scheibe = paste0(
      "an item is considered stable when the net change between the two rating ",
      "distributions does not exceed ", format(100 * cfg$scheibe), "% of ", base,
      ", a criterion based on Scheibe, Skutsch and Schofer (1975). The net ",
      "change is half the sum of the absolute differences between the shares of ",
      "experts in each class of the rating scale in the two rounds"
    ),
    both = paste0(
      "an item is considered stable when the ", test, " is not significant at ",
      "the ", format(cfg$alpha), " level and the net change between the two ",
      "rating distributions does not exceed ", format(100 * cfg$scheibe),
      "% of ", base, ", a criterion based on Scheibe, Skutsch and Schofer ",
      "(1975). The net change is half the sum of the absolute differences ",
      "between the shares of experts in each class of the rating scale in the ",
      "two rounds"
    )
  )
  design <- if (cfg$paired) {
    paste0(
      "Stability is assessed between consecutive rounds on the experts who ",
      "rated the item in both rounds, so that attrition is not mistaken for a ",
      "change of opinion: "
    )
  } else {
    paste0(
      "Since the experts cannot be identified across rounds, consecutive rounds ",
      "are compared as independent samples; differences between rounds ",
      "therefore reflect both changes of opinion and changes in the ",
      "composition of the panel: "
    )
  }
  cat("**Stability.** ", design, crit, ". Both criteria are reported in the ",
      "stability tables.\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

**Item status.** Consensus and stability are combined into four categories:

```{r status-table, results = "asis"}
cat(tab(data.frame(
  Status = c("Consensus", "Unstable consensus", "Stable dissent", "Open"),
  Consensus = c("Yes", "Yes", "No", "No"),
  Stable = c("Yes", "No", "Yes", "No"),
  `Further round` = c("No", "Yes", "No", "Yes"),
  check.names = FALSE
)), sep = "\n")
```

A stable dissent indicates that opinions have ceased to change without
converging; it is a substantive finding rather than a failure of the
process. `r if (!multi_round) "As only one round is available, stability cannot yet be assessed, and items are classified on the basis of consensus alone."`

# Panel participation

```{r panel, results = "asis"}
p <- delphi_panel(x)
if (!cfg$linked) {
  cat(tab(data.frame(Round = p$round, Respondents = p$respondents)), sep = "\n")
  cat("\nRespondents are the experts who provided at least one rating in a ",
      "round. The experts are not linked across rounds, so that retention ",
      "cannot be computed.\n", sep = "")
} else {
p_out <- data.frame(
  Round = p$round,
  Respondents = p$respondents,
  Retained = ifelse(is.na(p$retained), "n/a", p$retained),
  Dropped = ifelse(is.na(p$dropped), "n/a", p$dropped),
  Joined = ifelse(is.na(p$joined), "n/a", p$joined),
  `Retention since round 1` = pct(p$retention),
  check.names = FALSE
)
cat(tab(p_out), sep = "\n")
cat("\nRespondents are the experts who provided at least one rating in a ",
    "round. Retention is the share of first-round respondents who also took ",
    "part in each subsequent round.\n", sep = "")
}
```

# Results by indicator

```{r results-by-indicator, results = "asis", fig.height = facet_height}
for (ind in inds) {
  s <- x$scales[[ind]]
  r <- assessed[[ind]]
  cat("\n## ", cap(ind), " (rating scale ", scale_txt(s), ")\n\n", sep = "")

  cons <- delphi_consensus(
    x, threshold = cfg$threshold, relative_to = cfg$relative_to,
    round = r, indicator = ind, type = cfg$type
  )
  sti <- st[st$indicator == ind, ]
  out <- data.frame(
    Item = cons$item,
    n = cons$n,
    Median = cons$median,
    Q1 = cons$q1,
    Q3 = cons$q3,
    IQR = cons$iqr,
    `Relative IQR` = pct(cons$iqr_rel),
    Consensus = yes_no(cons$consensus),
    Status = cap(sti$status[match(cons$item, sti$item)]),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  cat("**Table.** Summary statistics and status of the items in round ", r,
      ".\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(tab(out), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n\n")

  if (multi_round) {
    sb <- stab[stab$indicator == ind, ]
    arrow <- paste(sb$round_from, "to", sb$round_to)
    if (cfg$paired) {
      sb_out <- data.frame(
        Item = sb$item,
        Rounds = arrow,
        `Paired n` = sb$n_paired,
        `Median change` = sb$median_change,
        `IQR change` = sb$iqr_change,
        `Experts who changed` = pct(sb$changed),
        `Wilcoxon p` = formatC(sb$p_value, format = "f", digits = 3),
        `Net change` = pct(sb$scheibe_change),
        Stable = yes_no(sb$stable),
        check.names = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      sb_out <- data.frame(
        Item = sb$item,
        Rounds = arrow,
        `n (from)` = sb$n_from,
        `n (to)` = sb$n_to,
        `Median change` = sb$median_change,
        `IQR change` = sb$iqr_change,
        `Rank-sum p` = formatC(sb$p_value, format = "f", digits = 3),
        `Net change` = pct(sb$scheibe_change),
        Stable = yes_no(sb$stable),
        check.names = FALSE
      )
    }
    cat("**Table.** Stability of the ratings between consecutive rounds.\n\n")
    cat(tab(sb_out), sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }

  print(delphi_plot_distribution(x, indicator = ind, ncol = 4))
  cat("\n\n")
  if (multi_round) {
    print(delphi_plot_trend(
      x, indicator = ind, ncol = 4, threshold = cfg$threshold,
      relative_to = cfg$relative_to, type = cfg$type
    ))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

  cat("\n# ", cap(inds[1]), " and ", inds[2], "\n\n", sep = "")

# Items for the next round

```{r next-round, results = "asis"}
levels_st <- c("consensus", "unstable consensus", "stable dissent", "open")
counts <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(
  factor(st$indicator, levels = inds),
  factor(st$status, levels = levels_st)
))
counts <- data.frame(
  Indicator = cap(rownames(counts)),
  Round = unname(assessed[rownames(counts)]),
  counts,
  check.names = FALSE
)
names(counts)[-(1:2)] <- cap(levels_st)
cat("**Table.** Number of items by status.\n\n")
cat(tab(counts), sep = "\n")
cat("\n\n")

nr <- st[st$next_round, ]
if (nrow(nr) == 0) {
  cat("No item requires a further round under the criteria adopted.\n")
} else {
  cat("The following items should be submitted to a further round, together ",
      "with the controlled feedback of the current one.\n\n", sep = "")
  nr_out <- data.frame(
    Indicator = cap(nr$indicator),
    Item = nr$item,
    Median = nr$median,
    IQR = nr$iqr,
    Status = cap(nr$status)
  )
  if (!is.null(cfg$item_labels)) {
    nr_out$Statement <- unname(cfg$item_labels[nr$item])
    nr_out$Statement[is.na(nr_out$Statement)] <- ""
  }
  cat(tab(nr_out), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r comments-setup, include = FALSE}
show_comments <- has_comments(x)
if (show_comments) {
  cm_rounds <- sort(unique(obj_comments(x)$round))
  r_ass <- max(unlist(assessed))
  r_c <- if (r_ass %in% cm_rounds) r_ass else max(cm_rounds)
  cm_all <- delphi_comments(x, round = r_c, type = cfg$type)
  cm_counts <- delphi_comment_counts(x, round = r_c, type = cfg$type)
  cm_counts <- cm_counts[cm_counts$n_comments > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  comments_height <- 1.8 + 0.25 * max(nrow(cm_counts), 1)
} else {
  comments_height <- 3
}
position_txt <- function(row) {
  pos <- vapply(inds, function(i) {
    p <- row[[paste0(i, "_position")]]
    if (is.na(p)) NA_character_ else paste(i, p)
  }, character(1))
  pos <- pos[!is.na(pos)]
  if (length(pos) == 0) "" else paste0("*Rating: ", paste(pos, collapse = ", "), ".* ")
}
```

```{r comments, results = "asis", fig.height = comments_height}
if (show_comments) {
  cat("\n# Expert comments\n\n")
  n_cm <- sum(!is.na(cm_all$item))
  n_gen <- sum(is.na(cm_all$item))
  n_auth <- length(unique(cm_all$expert))
  on_txt <- if (nrow(cm_counts) == n_items) {
    if (n_items == 1) "on the item" else paste0("on all ", n_items, " items")
  } else {
    paste0("on ", nrow(cm_counts), " of the ", n_items, " items")
  }
  cat(
    "In round ", r_c, ", ", plural(n_auth, "expert"), " wrote ",
    plural(n_cm, "comment"), " ", on_txt,
    if (n_gen > 0) paste0(", and ", plural(n_gen, "general comment")),
    ". Comments are reported anonymously. For each comment, the report ",
    "indicates whether the rating given by its author to the same item lies ",
    "below the first quartile, within the interquartile range or above the ",
    "third quartile of the ratings of the panel: comments from experts ",
    "outside the interquartile range present the arguments of the minority.\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  if (nrow(cm_counts) > 0) {
    cc_out <- data.frame(
      Item = cm_counts$item,
      Comments = cm_counts$n_comments,
      Experts = cm_counts$n_experts,
      `Share of the raters` = pct(cm_counts$share_experts),
      `From outside the IQR` = cm_counts$n_outside,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
    cat("**Table.** Comments by item. Comments from outside the IQR are those ",
        "whose author's rating lies outside the interquartile range on at ",
        "least one indicator.\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(tab(cc_out), sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
    print(delphi_plot_comments(x, round = r_c, type = cfg$type))
    cat("\n\n")
  }

  if (any(!is.na(cm_all$theme))) {
    th <- delphi_themes(x, round = r_c, by = "theme", type = cfg$type)
    th_out <- data.frame(
      Theme = th$theme,
      Comments = th$n_comments,
      Experts = th$n_experts,
      Items = th$items,
      `From outside the IQR` = th$n_outside,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
    cat("## Themes\n\n")
    cat("The comments were coded into themes by the researchers. A comment ",
        "coded with several themes is counted once for each of them.\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("**Table.** Themes of the comments.\n\n")
    cat(tab(th_out), sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }

  wd <- delphi_words(x, round = r_c, top = 15)
  if (nrow(wd) > 0) {
    cat("## Most frequent words\n\n")
    cat("Word frequencies are computed after removing common English and Italian ",
        "words, such as articles and prepositions. They give a descriptive ",
        "overview of the content of the comments and do not replace their ",
        "reading.\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("**Table.** The most frequent words in the comments.\n\n")
    cat(tab(data.frame(Word = wd$word, Occurrences = wd$n, Comments = wd$n_comments)),
        sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }

  if (cfg$comments != "none") {
    nr_items <- unique(st$item[st$next_round])
    if (cfg$comments == "next_round") {
      cat("## Comments on the items for the next round\n\n")
      list_items <- x$items[x$items %in% nr_items]
    } else {
      cat("## Comments on the items\n\n")
      list_items <- x$items
    }
    sel_items <- list_items[list_items %in% cm_all$item]
    if (cfg$comments == "next_round" && length(nr_items) == 0) {
      cat("No item requires a further round, so no comments are listed here.\n\n")
    } else if (length(sel_items) == 0) {
      cat("No comments were written on these items.\n\n")
    }
    for (it in sel_items) {
      lab <- if (!is.null(cfg$item_labels) && !is.na(cfg$item_labels[it])) {
        paste0(" ", md_escape(cfg$item_labels[[it]]))
      } else {
        ""
      }
      cat("**", it, ".**", lab, "\n\n", sep = "")
      rows <- cm_all[cm_all$item %in% it, , drop = FALSE]
      for (k in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
        cat("* ", position_txt(rows[k, , drop = FALSE]), md_escape(rows$comment[k]),
            "\n", sep = "")
      }
      cat("\n")
    }
    gen <- cm_all[is.na(cm_all$item), , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(gen) > 0) {
      cat("## General comments\n\n")
      for (k in seq_len(nrow(gen))) {
        cat("* ", md_escape(gen$comment[k]), "\n", sep = "")
      }
      cat("\n")
    }
  }
}
```
